related.title: Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程
related.titleEn: Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「多重且多樣的安全串列」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Redundant and diverse safety trains" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦英國唯一的壓水式機組：雙汽輪發電機、強化的安全串列與延役評估；Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程則以大型預製件吊裝、海底冷卻水隧道與高潮差海堤的土木工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on britain's only PWR: twin turbine generators, reinforced safety trains and life extension; Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering centres on civil engineering of heavy prefabricated lifts, subsea cooling-water tunnels and a sea wall for extreme tides, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「雙汽輪發電機配置」的模型移到Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「海底冷卻水隧道與取排水頭」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "The twin turbine-generator arrangement" to Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Subsea cooling-water tunnels and intake and outfall heads", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「多重且多樣的安全串列」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Redundant and diverse safety trains" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering must be respecified.

related.title: 馬鞍山核能三廠壓水式機組
related.titleEn: Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant PWR Units
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「多重且多樣的安全串列」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；馬鞍山核能三廠壓水式機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Redundant and diverse safety trains" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant PWR Units must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦英國唯一的壓水式機組：雙汽輪發電機、強化的安全串列與延役評估；馬鞍山核能三廠壓水式機組則以臺灣唯一的壓水式核電廠：318 全黑事件、鹽霧害與溫排水為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on britain's only PWR: twin turbine generators, reinforced safety trains and life extension; Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant PWR Units centres on taiwan's only PWR plant: the March 2001 station blackout, salt contamination and thermal discharge, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「雙汽輪發電機配置」的模型移到馬鞍山核能三廠壓水式機組，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「318 廠區全黑事件的時序」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "The twin turbine-generator arrangement" to Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant PWR Units, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sequence of the 18 March station blackout", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「多重且多樣的安全串列」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；馬鞍山核能三廠壓水式機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Redundant and diverse safety trains" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant PWR Units must be respecified.

history.title: 塞斯韋爾 B 壓水式核電廠
history.text: 1987 年政府核准興建；1988 年工程開工；1995 年併網並商轉；2017 年廠內乾式貯存設施啟用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1987: The government approved construction. 1988: Construction began. 1995: Grid connection and commercial operation. 2017: The on-site dry fuel store entered use. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
